title: Blessed Virgin Mary of the Rosary
short_summary: The Blessed Virgin Mary of the Rosary is kept in the Dominican calendar as a feast that turns Marian devotion toward contemplation of Christ and the mysteries of salvation.
key_facts: The Dominican Calendarium keeps the Blessed Virgin Mary of the Rosary as a feast on October 7.
The Order of Preachers connects this feast with the Church's celebration of the wonders of salvation.
The Rosary is a Marian prayer that leads the faithful to meditate on Christ.
This Dominican profile is local or proper in the app; the general U.S. calendar remains primary.

sections.heading: A Dominican Marian feast
sections.body: The Rosary has a deep place in Dominican devotion. In this feast, the Order honors Mary while directing prayer toward the saving mysteries of her Son.

sections.heading: Contemplating Christ with Mary
sections.body: The Rosary is not a distraction from Christ. It is a way of meditating on his life, death, and Resurrection with the Mother of the Lord.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Marian devotion ordered to Jesus
catholic_connection_sections.body: Catholic devotion to Mary is faithful when it leads more deeply into the mystery of Christ and the Gospel.
